events.content:
I've wrapped the slow data fetching logic inside a React `<Suspense>` boundary. 

By separating the slow `await getInventory()` call into a child `<InventoryDetails>` component, Next.js can now render the parent `ProductPage` immediately—showing the title right away—while the inventory data loads asynchronously. The project successfully builds with the `/product` page rendering partially static and streaming the rest.
